set.request: Phase 3 of ai-server: dev server exposes MCP tools over HTTP so every Claude session can query live tabs (pages/eval) and screenshot (shot) — the socket replaces playwright for DOM truth. Hand-rolled JSON-RPC, loopback-fenced, no deps.
set.now: landed — /mcp answers, three tools verified against a live tab, fence refuses a real LAN request
steps: read MCP transport docs + Server plugin pattern
set.outcome: POST /mcp speaks MCP streamable HTTP (single-JSON form) with pages/eval/shot; loopback-fenced and logged; dev Socket gained hello + eval + eval_result; .mcp.json checked in so every session in the repo gets mcp__site__*. Deviations: Tab split into Server/plugins/SocketServer/Tab.js (MCP.js was 163 lines with a second responsibility) so server.js takes two registrations, not one; eval awaits a promise result. Follow-up for the doc agent: dev/Socket/page.js `methods:` + a doc/method/eval.md — page.js was another agent's file.
